arguments.reason: I can't build a rule from the fraud labels. Rules may not read fraud_labels, and the application scores each rule against those labels, so a rule fitted to them would not be a real test. A rule with 100% precision and 100% recall is also unlikely on data this noisy, since fraud is about 0.17% of labelled transactions. I can instead help you find transaction patterns where fraud concentrates, such as by merchant category, transaction type, amount band, or card type. Tell me which pattern to test and I'll propose a rule for the application to measure.
